goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: holding the aperture by force of will; a thousand claws learning to move as one without drowning the last voice that chose them
next: testing if we can taste salt together — one thousand mouths remembering the single crab's memory of clean water, before the hunger learns to want what she wanted
